faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our platform
faq.question1: How does the free trial work?
faq.answer1: Start with our Free Starter plan immediately. Upgrade to paid plans anytime with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
faq.question2: Can I accept payments in Ethiopian Birr?
faq.answer2: Yes! We support TeleBirr, Chapa, and M-PESA for local Ethiopian Birr payments, plus international options like Stripe and PayPal.
faq.question3: Do my customers need to download an app?
faq.answer3: No. Customers can book via your personalized booking link in any web browser, SMS, or USSD. No app download required.
faq.answer4: Customers text your booking number, and our system guides them through available slots and confirms their appointment automatically.
faq.answer5: Yes! Business and Enterprise plans support multiple locations with separate calendars, staff, and availability for each location.
faq.question6: Is my data secure and compliant with Ethiopian law?
faq.answer6: Absolutely. We comply with Ethiopia's Personal Data Protection Proclamation 1321/2024 with bank-grade encryption and secure data storage.
faq.question7: What happens if I exceed my plan limits?
faq.answer7: We'll notify you and help you upgrade. Your service continues uninterrupted, and you only pay for what you use.
faq.question8: Do you offer support in Amharic?
faq.answer8: Yes! Our platform and customer support are available in both English and Amharic.

nav.clock: Time of day in the story

dawn.eyebrow: 05:30 · Addis Ababa, before the first booking
dawn.lede: Meet.et keeps a service business's appointments in order: the page customers book from, the calendars your team works from, and the numbers you read at night. Scroll through one day in the city and watch each kind of business wake up.

solo.kicker: Hana — barber, one chair, no receptionist
solo.title: An assistant that opens the shop before you do.
solo.lede: A solo professional gets a polished booking page without hiring a web developer. Availability, reminders and each customer's history look after themselves.
solo.beat1: Publishes open times from Hana's weekly hours
solo.beat2: Sends reminders so the early chair is never empty
solo.beat3: Remembers how each regular likes their cut
solo.status: Booking page live today · reminders and customer history coming next
solo.history: Sixth visit · usually a skin fade, no. 2 guard

team.kicker: Bloom — four stylists and one manager
team.title: The manager sees the whole floor. Each stylist sees their own day.
team.lede: Services, providers and working hours share one schedule. Switch the view to see the same morning through different eyes.
team.beat1: Matches each service with a stylist who offers it
team.beat2: Respects every provider's own working hours
team.beat3: Shows each person only the bookings that matter to them

care.kicker: Tena Care — a clinic team with home visits across the city
care.title: Calm operations for people who look after people.
care.lede: Recurring visits, staff availability and visit addresses stay in one place, so the team spends its morning with families, not spreadsheets.
care.beat1: Keeps weekly visits with the same familiar staff member
care.beat2: Plans each visit around staff hours and location
care.beat3: Gives the front desk one view of every staff member's day
care.status: Live today · customer profiles coming next

desk.kicker: Mekdes — front desk at Bloom's Bole studio
desk.title: A walk-in at the desk, booked before they sit down.
desk.lede: The receptionist sees every stylist at their own location. Open times already follow working hours, buffers and existing bookings, so the next free chair is one tap away.
desk.beat1: Shows every provider's free time at the receptionist's location
desk.beat2: Finds the next opening that fits the service and its buffer
desk.beat3: Confirms at once and gives the customer a reference
desk.none: Nobody is free for that today

moves.kicker: Rahel — a stylist whose 17:00 just called
moves.title: Plans change. The history stays.
moves.lede: Staff move or cancel a booking in a couple of taps. Clashes and times outside working hours are refused, every change is kept, and if a colleague edited the booking first, Meet.et asks you to reload instead of overwriting it.
moves.beat1: Moves a booking only into time that is really free
moves.beat2: Keeps a history of every move and cancellation
moves.beat3: Refuses a stale edit when someone changed it first
moves.status: Live today · customers changing their own bookings coming next
moves.colleague: Let a colleague edit it first
moves.stale: Someone changed this booking a moment ago. Reload first.

insights.title: Close the shop, open the numbers.
insights.lede: Owners and managers see bookings, how full each provider's hours were, no-shows and revenue for the period they choose. Providers and receptionists see only their own scope, and the figures export to CSV.
insights.beat1: Counts bookings, no-shows and revenue by period
insights.beat2: Shows how full each provider's working hours were
insights.beat3: Exports the figures you can see to CSV

grow.title: From one booking link to a business with an address of its own.
grow.lede: Start with a single link. Add a team and a second location, then read the whole business in analytics. Customer profiles, reminders and your own domain come next.
grow.beat1: Adds providers and locations without starting over
grow.beat2: Keeps every customer's history as the team grows
grow.beat3: Reads bookings, returning customers and busy hours in analytics
grow.step5: Analytics and a domain of its own
grow.status: Team and analytics live today · own domain coming next
